title: 第21章 学院规矩第22章 牧帆惊讶
content_zh:
牧帆要加入临水学院，方凌几个学院的弟子都还是挺高兴的。
一来，牧帆天赋如此之高，是他们需要仰望的，对他们来说谈不上是对手。
二来，吴长老和学院还会奖励他们。
因为牧帆的事迹，几人都还在惊叹中，甚至已经期待起牧帆进入学院之后会有什么亮眼表现了。
吴长老笑道：“你们似乎忽视了一件事。”
谢玉好奇的问道：“吴长老，我们忽视什么了？”
吴长老道：“萧钟是玄武境九重，而牧帆是玄武境六重。”
几人顿时恍然。
是啊，整整相差三重的差距！
在他们几人的认知中，只有学院中最顶尖的武道天才，才能跨境界战斗。
不过，这直接跨三重境界斩杀对手，这可绝对不存在！
吴长老并没有要继续了解的意思，望着牧帆，“从现在开始，你就是临水学院的一员了！”
牧帆点头。
吴长老道：“还有三天时间，周云岭招收新弟子就结束，我们也可以回学院了，这几天你就直接跟着我们一起招收新弟子得了。”
牧帆点头，“可以。”
“对了，牧帆，方便我查看一下你的武脉吗？”
吴长老想了想，还是开口问道。
吴长老也知道，武脉被废，就没有修复的说法，所以想要确认一下牧帆的武脉究竟如何，他并没有直接说要查看，而是询问牧帆是否答应，也是给足了面子。
否则若是面对一般的弟子，吴长老会给什么面子？
牧帆并没有拒绝，“这个当然可以。”

得到认可，吴长老将手臂放在牧帆的肩膀上，用意念来查看牧帆的武脉。
武脉，和身体普通的经脉不一样，很是突出，经脉上有一道经络环绕，就是最次的一等武脉，有两道经络，就是二等武脉……
而牧帆的武脉，并没有经络环绕，但是格外粗壮，灵气在其中涌动。
“最次的武脉也应该有一道经络才对，他的武脉，却一道经络都没有，不过灵气转化速度却异常的快，加上他修炼速度也这么快，那就可以确定他的武脉品质绝对不差，难道真是只在传说中的至尊武脉？”
吴长老心中嘀咕道，确认牧帆的武脉没有问题，便将手收回，对于牧帆的天赋，更加看重了几分。
他可是在典籍中听说过，至尊武脉拥有者——天生至尊！
如此一幕，让周围的人羡慕不已。
“不愧是牧帆，都不需要任何考核，不像我们……”
“牧帆可是周云岭第一天才，甚至整个临水郡中都出名，岂是你们可以相比？”
“也是。”
……
牧帆来到枉安城，要加入临水学院的消息迅速传遍整个枉安城。
萧家担心牧帆会来报复，因此提前派出人来向牧帆赔礼道歉。
对此，牧帆并没有在意，对于萧家送来的储物灵戒，自然是直接收下。
里面好东西不少，可惜还是一样，对修为提升有显着效果的并没有。
content_en:
Mu Fan is going to join Linshui College, and Fang Ling's disciples in several colleges are quite happy.
First of all, Mufan's talent is so high that they need to look up to him, and he can't be said to be a rival for them.
Secondly, Elder Wu and the academy will also reward them.
Because of Mu Fan's deeds, several people were still in awe, and even looked forward to Mu Fan's outstanding performance after entering the academy.
Elder Wu smiled and said, "You seem to have overlooked one thing."
Xie Yu asked curiously: "Elder Wu, what have we overlooked?"
Elder Wu said: "Xiao Zhong is at the ninth level of the Xuanwu Realm, and Mu Fan is at the sixth level of the Xuanwu Realm."
Several people suddenly realized.
Yes, a total difference of three times!
In their understanding, only the top martial arts geniuses in the academy can fight across realms.
However, directly killing the opponent across the three realms is absolutely non-existent!
Elder Wu had no intention of further understanding, and looked at Mu Fan, "From now on, you will be a member of Linshui Academy!"
Mufan nodded.
Elder Wu said: "There are still three days left. Zhou Yunling's recruitment of new disciples will be over. We can also go back to the academy. You can just follow us to recruit new disciples in the past few days."
Mufan nodded, "Okay."
"By the way, Mu Fan, can I check your martial arts veins?"
Elder Wu thought for a while and then asked.
Elder Wu also knew that if the martial arteries were abolished, there was no way to repair them, so he wanted to confirm the condition of Mu Fan's martial arteries. He did not directly say that he wanted to check, but asked Mu Fan if he agreed, which also gave him enough face.
Otherwise, what face would Elder Wu give to ordinary disciples?
Mufan did not refuse, "Of course you can."
After receiving approval, Elder Wu put his arm on Mu Fan's shoulder and used his mind to check Mu Fan's martial veins.
The martial arteries are different from the ordinary meridians in the body. They are very prominent. There is one meridian surrounding the meridians, which is the first-class martial arteries. There are two meridians, which are the second-class martial arteries...
Mu Fan's martial arteries were not surrounded by meridians, but they were extremely strong, with spiritual energy surging in them.
"The most inferior martial arteries should have a meridian, but his martial arteries don't have a single meridian. However, the spiritual energy transformation speed is extremely fast, and his cultivation speed is also so fast, so we can be sure that the quality of his martial arteries is definitely not bad. Is it really the supreme martial arteries only in legends?"
Elder Wu muttered in his heart, and after confirming that there was no problem with Mu Fan's martial arts, he retracted his hand and valued Mu Fan's talent even more.
He had heard in the classics that the possessor of the Supreme Martial Lineage was born supreme!
Such a scene made everyone around envious.
"As expected of Mu Fan, he doesn't need any assessment, unlike us..."
"Mu Fan is the number one genius in Zhou Yunling, and is even famous in the entire Linshui County. How can you compare?"
"Same."
…
Mu Fan came to Fu'an City, and the news that he was going to join Linshui College quickly spread throughout Fu'an City.
The Xiao family was worried that Mu Fan would retaliate, so they sent someone to apologize to Mu Fan in advance.
Mu Fan didn't care about this, and naturally accepted the storage ring sent by the Xiao family.
There are a lot of good things in it, but unfortunately it's still the same, and there's nothing that has a significant effect on improving your cultivation.
